The 2020 Audi A7 3.0T Prestige quattro delivers sophisticated performance and refined luxury in a stunning blue finish. This sedan represents a compelling combination of advanced technology, premium comfort, and dynamic driving capabilities that rewards both daily commuting and spirited driving.

- Bang & Olufsen 3D Premium Sound System with 16 speakers
- HD Matrix-Design LED Headlights with Audi Laser Light
- Audi Virtual Cockpit Plus with 12.3" fully digital instrument cluster
- Head-Up Display projecting driving information into your field of vision
- Audi Adaptive Cruise Assist with Traffic Jam Assist
- Sport Suspension with 20mm drop for refined handling
- 4-Zone Automatic Climate Control
- Heated and Ventilated Front Seats with 4-way power lumbar support
- Heated Rear Seats and Manual Rear Window Sunshade
- Top View Camera System with Virtual 360 View
- Audi Active Lane Assist and Audi Side Assist with Rear Cross Traffic
- Audi Phone Box with Wireless Charging
- Power Soft-Closing Doors
- 21" 5-V-Spoke-Star-Design Bi-Color Wheels on summer tires
- S Line Package with exterior styling and illuminated door sills

Powered by a 3.0L V6 TFSI engine paired with a 6-speed automatic S tronic transmission, this A7 delivers responsive acceleration while maintaining respectable fuel economy at 22 city and 29 highway mpg. The quattro all-wheel-drive system ensures confident traction in varied driving conditions, while the sport suspension engineered with a 20mm drop enhances the sedan's handling characteristics and visual presence.

The interior reflects Audi's commitment to quality and precision. Dark brown walnut wood accents throughout the cabin complement leather seating surfaces and genuine wood trim. The Audi Virtual Cockpit Plus eliminates the traditional dashboard gauge cluster in favor of a comprehensive digital display, while the Head-Up Display presents critical information directly in your line of sight. MMI Navigation Plus guides your route with intuitive control, and wireless smartphone integration ensures seamless connectivity.

Driver assistance and safety systems provide peace of mind on every journey. Audi Pre Sense Rear, Traffic Sign Recognition, and Intersection Assist work together to enhance awareness. The Top View Camera System generates a virtual 360-degree perspective around the vehicle, simplifying parking and low-speed maneuvering. Multiple airbags, electronic stability control, and four-wheel independent suspension contribute to overall protection and control.

- 18" Gloss Graphite Aluminum Alloy Wheels
- Remote Keyless Entry with Security System

- Telescoping and Tilt Steering Wheel

The XSE trim elevates your driving experience with amenities that matter. The JBL Premium Audio system delivers crisp sound quality while the wireless charger keeps your devices powered throughout your day. Heated front sport seats provide comfort during colder months, and the dual zone automatic climate control allows both driver and passenger to set preferred temperatures independently. The leather steering wheel and shift knob add a refined feel to the cabin.

Safety features are thoughtfully integrated throughout the vehicle. Blind Spot Monitor technology with Rear Cross-Traffic Alert helps you navigate with greater awareness, while the exterior parking camera assists during reversing. You'll benefit from Electronic Stability Control, Traction Control, Brake Assist, and a comprehensive airbag system including dual front, front side, knee, and overhead airbags designed to protect occupants in various impact scenarios.

Efficiency and performance work together in this hatchback. The 2.0L 4-cylinder engine paired with a continuously variable transmission achieves 30 mpg city and 38 mpg highway, delivering the fuel economy that helps reduce frequent fill-ups. The responsive steering, independent four-wheel suspension, and anti-roll bars combine to create balanced handling that makes driving predictable and controlled.

Exterior styling complements the vehicle's practical nature. The 18-inch gloss graphite aluminum alloy wheels provide an upscale appearance, while LED daytime running lights with integrated fog lights enhance visibility and give the front end a modern presence. Heated power mirrors with turn signal indicators, a rear spoiler, and body-color bumpers complete the cohesive design. The rear window wiper and variably intermittent front wipers ensure clear visibility regardless of weather conditions.

This 2023 Corolla Hatchback XSE represents solid value for those seeking a certified vehicle backed by Toyota's reputation for reliability. The GTI combines daily practicality with genuine driving engagement. The turbocharged engine pairs responsiveness with fuel efficiency, while the dual-clutch automatic transmission delivers smooth shifts whether you're navigating city streets or cruising the highway. The sport-tuned suspension and speed-sensing steering create confidence through every corner, making this the kind of vehicle that transforms ordinary commutes into engaging drives.

Inside, the driver-focused cockpit puts everything you need within easy reach. Heated sport seats wrapped in premium materials cradle you during spirited driving, while the heated steering wheel adds comfort during cold mornings. The MIB3 touchscreen infotainment system integrates seamlessly with steering wheel controls, allowing you to manage audio and functions without taking your hands off the wheel. Automatic climate control maintains your preferred temperature throughout the cabin.

Safety technology is built in throughout. Autonomous emergency braking with forward collision warning helps protect you and your passengers, while lane departure warning keeps you aware of your position on the road. The rearview camera assists with parking precision, and electronic stability control works continuously to maintain traction in challenging conditions.

The Golf GTI's practical interior accommodates five passengers comfortably, with split-folding rear seats that expand cargo versatility when you need to carry more. Four-wheel independent suspension absorbs road imperfections while maintaining responsive handling, and four-wheel disc brakes with ABS provide confident stopping power.

This is a vehicle built for drivers who appreciate quality, performance, and reliability. It's ready to become your trusted companion for whatever drives you have planned. - Auto high-beam headlights with fog lights

The power-adjustable driver seat with lumbar support accommodates different body types, while the split-folding rear seat provides flexible cargo space when you need it. Steering wheel-mounted audio controls keep your attention on the road while adjusting music or answering calls.

Convenience features make daily driving more enjoyable. The power moonroof adds natural light and an open-air feel to the cabin. Remote keyless entry, illuminated entry, and automatic headlights with delay-off function simplify routine tasks. The rear window defroster and variably intermittent wipers help maintain visibility in changing weather conditions.

The exterior displays tasteful styling with a body-color bumper, power door mirrors, and a rear spoiler. Alloy wheels add a polished appearance while supporting the sedan's responsive handling. The gray paint complements the Civic's clean, modern design.

Dual front and side impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags create multiple layers of occupant protection.

Entertainment and connectivity are handled through the Audi MMI Navigation Plus system with radio data system and SiriusXM, complemented by a 17-speaker Bang & Olufsen sound system featuring 3D sound technology. The Head-Up Display projects essential driving information directly into your line of sight, while the heated steering wheel and power moonroof add layers of comfort and convenience.

This S8 is presented in white exterior finish with premium 21-inch gloss black wheels from the S8 Black Optic Plus Package, high-gloss black exterior elements, and black Audi rings and badges. The extended leather package, black Dinamica headliner, and comprehensive comfort appointments reflect the meticulous attention to detail throughout this vehicle.

The Premium Package elevates the ownership experience through a collection of refined amenities. The fixed panoramic glass roof floods the cabin with natural light, while the Surround View system aids in navigation and parking awareness. The fixed panoramic glass roof floods the cabin with natural light. The BOSE surround sound system delivers clear audio throughout the spacious cabin.

Advanced driver assistance features including Lane Change Assist and Adaptive Cruise Control contribute to confident, less fatiguing driving on modern highways. The adaptive suspension system absorbs road irregularities while maintaining dynamic response, supported by electronically controlled all-wheel independent suspension geometry that works continuously to balance comfort with handling precision.

This Taycan 4S represents a meaningful investment in electric mobility without compromise. With meticulous attention to build quality and performance-oriented engineering, it stands ready to serve the discerning driver seeking both capability and refinement. We invite you to experience this vehicle firsthand in our showroom.

VEHICLE OVERVIEW:
This 2022 Porsche Taycan 4S is a beautifully optioned, highly capable expression of Porsche's all-electric sports sedan, commanding a high-spec original MSRP of $122,260. Finished in the sophisticated, metallic depth of factory Volcano Grey Metallic, this example projects an incredibly sleek and technical road presence. The modern silhouette is perfectly anchored by upgraded 20-inch Taycan Turbo Aero wheels wrapped in versatile all-season tires, giving it a premium stance without compromising range efficiency. Fully documented with a verified original warranty start date, this dual-motor performance sedan represents a fantastic acquisition opportunity for anyone looking to enter the world of high-performance electric luxury.

At its mechanical core, the Taycan 4S features dual permanent magnet synchronous motors powering an intelligent all-wheel-drive system. This specific build is heavily upgraded with the coveted Performance Battery Plus (93.4 kWh) package, expanding total power output up to a thrilling 562 horsepower on overboost while lengthening driving range capability. Charging usability is optimized with dual factory power-closing charge port covers, the upgraded Mobile Charger Connect setup, an extended 25-foot charging cable, and the Porsche Intelligent Range Manager software to dynamically map out long-distance charging routes.

Inside, the clean, driver-centric cockpit is swathed in a classic Black standard interior. The front cabin treats occupants to premium 14-way Power Sport Seats featuring comfort memory, multi-stage heating, and cooling ventilation, all framed by an optional heated steering wheel and a striking Fixed Panoramic Glass Roof that floods the cabin with natural light. The digital workspace provides complete highway safety and spatial awareness via the comprehensive Premium Package ($6,020), loading the cockpit with a 360-degree Surround View camera layout, Lane Change Assist (LCA), and a cabin air ionizer. Rounded out by a rich, deeply clear BOSE® Surround Sound system, this Volcano Grey 4S delivers the ultimate blend of zero-emission daily utility and unmistakable Porsche sports sedan DNA.

description:
The 2021 Mercedes-Benz S-Class S 580 4MATIC is a full-size luxury sedan with all-wheel drive and a focus on comfort, refinement, and a high level of standard equipment. The S 580 designation places it within the upper end of the S-Class range, and the 4MATIC system indicates power sent to all four wheels. Its size and proportions reflect the priorities of the model line, with a long wheelbase profile, substantial cabin space, and a quiet, insulated driving environment. The overall presentation is formal and restrained, with an emphasis on measured engineering rather than visual excess. As part of the S-Class family, it is built to handle long-distance travel, daily commuting, and passenger transport with a consistent approach to smoothness and composure.

Inside, the cabin is trimmed with leather seats, which give the interior a more finished and traditional luxury appearance. The seating surfaces are arranged for comfort over extended drives, and the material choice is consistent with the vehicle's place in the Mercedes-Benz lineup. A panoramic sunroof is included and adds overhead glass coverage that brings more natural light into the passenger area. The interior design of the S-Class places controls and displays within easy reach of the driver while maintaining a calm visual layout. Materials, switchgear, and trim are coordinated in a way that suits a flagship sedan, with attention paid to fit and surface quality rather than ornament for its own sake. The result is a cabin that feels deliberate and well resolved without relying on dramatic details.

Driver-assistance equipment includes Adaptive Cruise Control, Lane Keep Assist, and Collision Warning. These systems add electronic support during highway and urban driving, and they are part of the vehicle's broader effort to reduce workload without removing the driver from the process. Adaptive Cruise Control maintains a set following distance in traffic, while Lane Keep Assist provides steering support within marked lanes. Collision Warning adds another layer of monitoring for changing conditions ahead. These features are integrated into the vehicle rather than added as separate afterthoughts, and they work alongside the sedan's fundamental road manners. The S-Class platform is known for steady control and a composed ride, and this particular example adds the convenience of active assistance to that basic character. The controls for these systems are presented in a way that fits the overall interior logic, with information delivered through the car's display interfaces and driver-facing instrumentation.

Premium Audio is also specified, giving the vehicle an upgraded sound system for music, radio, and other media sources. The electric drivetrain combines efficiency with environmental responsibility, eliminating the need for oil changes and reducing your long-term operating costs significantly.

This vehicle prioritizes comfort through dual-zone climate control with individual temperature management for driver and passenger, heated front and rear seats for cold-weather driving, and a heated steering wheel for enhanced convenience. Ambient lighting and illuminated entry features ease your transition into the vehicle, while front and rear reading lights support visibility throughout the cabin.

The system includes lane departure warning, electronic stability control, traction control, and a comprehensive airbag array including dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags. Four-wheel independent suspension delivers balanced handling, while speed-sensing steering adjusts responsiveness based on driving conditions. The rear-view parking camera provides visibility when reversing, and an emergency communication system offers additional peace of mind.

Navigation capabilities are integrated directly into the vehicle, guided by a compass display and trip computer that tracks efficiency data. Steering wheel-mounted controls for audio and climate functions allow you to adjust settings without taking your hands from the wheel. Auto-dimming door mirrors and rear-view mirror reduce glare, while rain-sensing wipers respond automatically to weather conditions.

This 2025 Model 3 combines efficiency, safety, and thoughtful engineering to support your daily driving needs. We invite you to visit our showroom to explore this vehicle in person and discuss how it fits your lifestyle.
